verdict.rationale: Google publishes a first-party GitHub repository (google/google-authenticator) containing the project's OTP generator implementations for several mobile platforms, plus a linked PAM module, so the source is readable. However, no evidence states which license applies, and nothing confirms that the repo matches the current shipping app (which now has Google Account cloud sync). Missing for 10: explicit open-license evidence (license name or terms), confirmation that the published source corresponds to the current app, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: The Google Authenticator project includes implementations of one-time passcode generators for several mobile platforms.
These implementations support the HMAC-Based One-time Password (HOTP) algorithm specified in RFC 4226 and the Time-based One-time Password (TOTP) algorithm specified in RFC 6238.
